Name: Roses or Flying Cabbages
Author: Kamalei
Description:
[center][b][size=6][color=red]!!!!!!!!!!! Read[/color][/size]
[/b]Big rose or cabbage

﻿[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/8jxDVYUgaNZzxYTncw/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611f199f817b671c8c1bccbf37f93d7b33a2006e677&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]
﻿Light pink, light blue and red turning roses

[b]What is this?[/b]
A mod that adds small turning roses to your Stardew experience. Due to my bad pixelskills, you can also interpret them as cabbages! They only spawn on the farm, forest, backwoods, woods, mountain, town and busstop.

[b]Why should I add this to my game?[/b]
You don't have to, they are just small roses, they don't add much except for moving visuals.

[b]Why did you make this?
[/b]At first I wanted to make more flying insects, but then I thought: It doesn't all have to be insects. Then I thought: let's make a beautiful turning, sprouting rose. Then I thought: MAKING IT TURN IS HARD. 36 FRAMES. And then sprouting?!?!? Nah. So now it may look like a rose or a cabbage, but it's a turning rose!

[b]How do I install?[/b]
Take the folder named kamalei.ladybug out of the .rar into your Customcritters/Critters folder. If you don't have a folder called "Critters" inside your Custom Critters folder, make one and throw the ladybug in there.
